data.name: Darnall
data.gender_notes: Darnall is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The Old English name Darnall is derived from the Old English elements dæor (dear) and nēall (valiant, brave). The name was used to describe a person who was dearly loved and possessed great courage and strength. The name Darnall carries the meaning “Valiant, brave” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Darnall usually hope their child will grow to embody valiant, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Darnall belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Valiant, brave.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Darnall total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_english.name: Darnall

It is a name that inspires us to be brave in the face of adversity, and to trust in God's love and grace to help us through life's trials.
